items.quote: I had the pleasure to visit Collier Automotive last week. I was having issues with A/C for a month. These guys fixed it in less than 5 minutes. Honest, small family business - I appreciate so much your help and kindness. I am glad I found an outstanding car repair shop. I will recommend to all my friends and family.  Thank you!!
John has been our mechanic since 2011 and the only one I trust completely.  Every quote has been below any competition and John, Geary and Brandon are consummate gentlemen. Highly recommend!

Outstanding.  Prices are competitive and fair, and they do high-quality work. Bottom line, these are car guys; they are passionate about the work.  The owner is honest and stands behind his price quotes.  Your search for auto work should start and end at Collier Automotive.  Mine did.
